properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/what_ifs_and_what_goes_stale.rs. Class invariants over the trolley, cogito and argument-trial capstone designs and the five proof trials: a what-if on any assumed principle reads every position resting on it (trolley: dropping act consequentialism leaves the footbridge push unsupported, the switch turn still supported by double effect); a what-if from a premise never fans down a sibling DECOMPOSES; every row says what its claim read before; a contested claim's loss and returning objections are named; a passing check whose reasoned conditions lose support reads stale; a claim derived under a refuted supposition says so; loop_status names what has lost its reason now; a requirement's read-back follows its reason to the evidence. All nine failed on main 48f2865 and pass on the branch.
